};
const boxGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1,1,1);
function meshBox(parent, material, pos, size, cast=true) { const m=new THREE.Mesh(boxGeo,material); m.position.set(...pos); m.scale.set(...size); m.castShadow=cast; m.receiveShadow=true; parent.add(m); return m; }

 // arena spawn plates
 ring(3.2,.09,mats.cyan,.025);ring(3.2,.09,mats.orange,.025);
 return obstacles;
